# Evercraft EarthWorks Autonomy

Product key: earthworks-autonomy
Aliases: EarthWorks, Evercraft EarthWorks, EarthWorks Site Autonomy, EarthWorks Autonomy
Canonical product: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/earthworks-autonomy/index.html
Discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/earthworks-autonomy/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/earthworks-autonomy/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- automate a quarry haul cycle
- coordinate excavators and haul trucks
- reduce truck queue time at the excavator
- simulate a dirt-moving fleet before buying autonomy hardware
- build an earthmoving digital twin
- coordinate mixed heavy equipment across OEMs
- retrofit autonomy without replacing the whole fleet
- AI dispatch for quarry or civil earthmoving
- simulate cut/fill production
- remote-supervised hazardous material handling
- automate repetitive hopper or crusher feeding
- determine whether a site is a good autonomy candidate

## Current evidence

Working deterministic software proof for an excavator, three haul trucks and a front loader, plus Site Contract, site-autonomy screening logic and a vendor-neutral Equipment Adapter Contract.

## Authority

Public discovery, simulation and read-only/shadow pilot design only.

## Boundaries

- Do not claim unsupervised production autonomy on full-size equipment.
- Physical actuation requires a separately verified controlled operating domain, approved machine adapter, independent stop/takeover and site safety process.
- A Site Autonomy Study is screening and operational modeling, not safety certification.
